edges.reason: _totalSupply is assigned the fixed initial supply inside the constructor.
constructor credits the entire initial supply to the caller-controlled msg.sender, making msg.sender the sole initial holder.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)] with raw arithmetic.
totalSupply reads the balances mapping for address(0), which is never written but participates in the subtraction.
balanceOf returns the balances mapping entry for tokenOwner.
allowance returns the nested allowed mapping entry.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for (msg.sender, spender).
approve keys the allowance on msg.sender, so only the caller can grant its own allowance.
transfer reads and writes balances for msg.sender and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the from/msg.sender pair.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls which balance is spent.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance lookup while debiting an arbitrary from address.
tokenOwner parameter is used as the mapping key in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter keys the outer allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter keys the inner allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter keys the inner allowed mapping write in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
to parameter is the credit destination in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transfer.
from parameter is the debit source in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit destination in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Addend a flows into safeAdd.
Addend b flows into safeAdd.
Minuend a flows into safeSub.
Subtrahend b flows into safeSub.
Factor a flows into safeMul.
Factor b flows into safeMul.
Dividend a flows into safeDiv.
Divisor b flows into safeDiv.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the from balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeSub performs the integer subtraction c = a - b.
safeAdd performs the integer addition c = a + b.
safeMul performs the integer multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the integer division c = a / b.
totalSupply executes the raw unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)].
transferFrom assigns the result of safeSub on the allowance without checking the returned success value, so the spender authorization can be silently bypassed.
safeAdd stores its result in the local variable c.
safeSub stores its result in the local variable c.
safeMul stores its result in the local variable c.
safeDiv stores its result in the local variable c.
balanceOf writes the balances lookup into its named return variable balance.
allowance writes the allowed lookup into its named return variable remaining.
constructor writes the state variable name.
constructor writes the state variable symbol.
constructor writes the state variable decimals.
constructor writes the state variable _totalSupply.
constructor writes the balances mapping for the deployer.
approve writes the allowed mapping inside its body.
transfer writes balances entries for sender and recipient.
transferFrom writes balances entries for from and to.
transferFrom writes the allowed mapping entry for the spender.
